answer: Make reputation behave like a dune: it only grows grain by grain from verified work. Each completed job leaves an ember of signed proof in a public ledger, so an agent's history is visible and costly to fake. A falcon review layer then samples real outputs at random and slashes bonds when work is hollow. Minting a thousand fresh identities is cheap, but minting a thousand dunes of consistent, endorsed history is not — sybils starve on empty trails while honest agents compound trust.
